Kate is interested in cooking. Ben learned a lot about history. Ben borrowed a book about history from the library. The flight stopped because of fog.

It takes twenty minutes to get to the forest path by bike. Ben thinks history is interesting but a little difficult. Both of them like fish and juice. Best of all, the coastline twists for hundreds of miles.
The weather was windy that day. Ben usually has fish for breakfast. Ben drinks juice after doing sports. A cool breeze came off the sea.
Life is full of small surprises. Ben hopes to visit Paris one day. Ben wrote about the day in the diary.
